this reporting period, which, for lack of a better choice, | characterized as as the loan being “redeemed.” No interest was charged; only principal was repaid.

Bond Index, Oppenheimer Intl Bond Fund, and COL shrt Dur USDG (government bond fund). APPL, O, and COL shrt Dur USDG were listed as "assets™ with

zero value at the time of the Initial Report. DWS US Bond Index and Oppenheimer Intl Bond Fund were erroneously listed WITH values, although they actually

had been sold. As those five assets were not in my possession during the reporting period for this report (January 1, 2014 through December 31, 2014), they do

Section VIL, lines 72-75 - On 5/13/18, my father's widow passed away and | became the trustee of a trust (Trusts #2) with two assets, One was an investment

account at Fidelity Investments consisting only of Apple stock. As trustee, | sold the stock and closed the account and distributed the proceeds equally tothe six

beneficiaries, of which T was one. The other was an annuity with Genworth Financial (Secureliving Income Provider Fixed Immediate Annuity) for which there

were also six heirs of the trust, of which I am one. As trustee, 1 made an irrevocable directive for the annuity payments to be made to the six heirs of the trust.

trustee. As noted, | recorded these assets in my capacity as trustee, Without a more precise descriptor available, | accounted for the assets with the “acquisition”

code of “buy.”
